global_style: Gritty industrial realism; high-contrast chiaroscuro; dominant orange firelight against deep blacks; sweaty textures, soot, metal gleam and violent sparks; claustrophobic, kinetic framing.

project_settings.location_lock: Subterranean cave forge, undetermined locale — DO NOT infer or depict a specific country, culture, or fantasy realm (NOT medieval Europe, NOT feudal Japan, NOT Norse, NOT dwarven/Tolkien).
negative_constraints: Modern power tools (angle grinder, plasma cutter, electric welder)
Chrome or stainless steel polished finishes
Ornate jewelry inlays, gemstones, gold leaf
Stylized cultural masks (Kabuki, Oni, Venetian, tribal)
Crowds or additional people; the blacksmith is alone
External light sources other than the forge fire

style_overrides.color_palette: Firelit amber/orange highlights with deep charcoal and black shadows; gritty, high contrast.
style_overrides.architecture: Natural rough cave walls and stone; minimal, utilitarian forge fixtures only.
style_overrides.lighting: Single practical source: forge/fire glow; chiaroscuro; no fill, rim, overhead, or electric lights.
style_overrides.materials: Black iron/steel, raw stone, soot, ash; avoid polished or decorative finishes.
style_overrides.props: Manual smithing tools only (anvil, hammer, tongs); no powered equipment.
style_overrides.costume: Functional, neutral workwear (heavy apron, gloves); no cultural insignia or ornament.
style_overrides.set_dressing: Sparse, utilitarian; focus on labor and tools; no signage, logos, or decorative motifs.
style_overrides.mood: Tense, gritty, urgent; physical exertion emphasized by sparks and darkness.

project_settings.era_lock: Atemporal, era-agnostic underground workshop — no overt historical markers (NOT medieval, NOT steampunk, NOT cyberpunk, NOT futuristic sci‑fi).

key_events: A lone blacksmith hammers a red-hot metal mask on an anvil.
Each strike explodes sparks, briefly lighting his exhausted, soot-stained face.
He works against the clock with intense physical exertion.
Forge fire serves as the only light source, heightening drama.
narrative_context.cultural_context: Undisclosed; emphasis on craftsmanship and labor within a subterranean workshop.

characters.name: Blacksmith
characters.description: Muscular, sweat- and soot-covered man in a grimy grey tank top; exhausted, determined eyes; powerful arms; face intermittently illuminated by forge sparks in a dark cave.
characters.clothing_style: Grimy grey tank top, heavy work pants, worn leather boots, soot smudges.
characters.voice_description: Low, breathy grunts; strained breathing under exertion.
characters.personality: Relentless, focused, stoic, driven by urgency.
characters.backstory: Unstated; a skilled metalworker operating in a hidden cave forge.
characters.current_motivation: Shape a metal mask before time runs out.

locations.name: Cave Forge
locations.visual_style: Dark, gritty cave; roaring forge fire casts fierce orange glow; high-contrast shadows, smoky air, showers of sparks.

props.name: Steel Anvil
props.visual_description: Heavy steel anvil with worn edges, solidly anchored, glinting under orange forge light.

props.name: Iron Hammer
props.visual_description: Massive iron sledgehammer, darkened head and sturdy handle, used for powerful forging strikes.

props.name: Metal Mask
props.visual_description: Glowing red-hot metal mask blank on the anvil, edges sparkling as it’s shaped under heavy blows.

props.name: Forge Fire
props.visual_description: Raging forge with fierce orange flames and intense heat; primary light source driving dramatic contrast.
